text_block_list.text:
Trainer... We've had a good run, but I'm
afraid I'm
done for...
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип
choice_data_list: What in the world do you mean?

text_block_list.text:
I appreciate the concern, but this is
something
I've gotta take care of myself.
Please, forget I
said anything!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип
choice_data_list: Don't say that. I want to help.

text_block_list.text:
You're too nice for you own good. But
since you
insist, I'll tell you. The thing
is...
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
I've got a honkin' huge zit on my
forehead, and it
hurts like Heckle and
Jyde!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: Sigh... Think my life will ever be the same?
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
I'm relieved it's nothing life-threatening,
but she's
very concerned about her skin.
I take note to be
more understanding of
that moving forward.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
